_comment: Wrapper-backed capacity that emits an outbound intention and waits for the correlated response.

objective.name: sandbox.emit.await
objective.description: Emit an outbound intention through the wrapper runtime and await the response

#root.role: Emit an outbound intention to another context, await the correlated response, and return the remote payload.

effects.outbound_route: The wrapper emits and awaits an outbound intention.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local wrapper request becomes a remote correlated payload returned through one awaited outbound route.
invariants: sandbox.emit.await must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sandbox.emit.await returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sandbox.emit.await fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
